provenance: Original compositions using CC0 VCSL and Karoryfer recordings alongside FM/modal synthesis and seeded noise percussion. Exact sources, hashes and licences: sources/manifest.json. No rejected audio reused.
measurement: Final PCM: measured integrated LUFS, true peak and loudness range using FFmpeg loudnorm. No speech intelligibility claim.

tracks.name: Paper Lantern
tracks.description: Electric piano and recorded bass in a lopsided pocket. Higher chord inversions and short answers enter near the end.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Side Street
tracks.description: Fingerpicked archtop guitar, rim and soft shakers. Syncopation supplies movement; the last phrase lands on an open sixth.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Night Platform
tracks.description: Short velvet chords over skipping two-step drums. A mid-piece break makes room for a fuller return.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Soft Focus
tracks.description: A steady four, muted chord pulses and an offbeat bass. The chord filter opens gradually; a short breath precedes zero.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Atlas
tracks.description: Interlocking wooden notes over a three-against-four hand-percussion pattern. A second answering line enters in the final phrases.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Velvet Relay
tracks.description: Clipped strings and a dry backbeat. The bass shifts into octaves and short guitar answers join the final phrases.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Glass Arcade
tracks.description: Slow half-time drums, glassy chords and a sparse descending motif. Wide space first, more rhythmic detail near the finish.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP

tracks.name: Sunday Club
tracks.description: Three beats, a recorded walking electric bass and brushed texture. A restrained piano trio with a harmonic lift rather than a drum build.
tracks.method: FFmpeg loudnorm, two-pass, target -23 LUFS / -2 dBTP
